fallacy_scan_11_of_11.simpsons_paradox: Per-bearing LOBO results are primary; no pooled trajectory correlation.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.ecological_fallacy: Bearing is the evaluation unit; time samples are dependent.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.berkson_bias: Laboratory run-to-failure bearings are selected trajectories.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.collider_bias: No conditioned causal comparison is made.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.base_rate_neglect: Movement event fraction is reported per held-out bearing.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.regression_to_mean: No intervention or before-after causal claim.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.survivorship_bias: Complete trajectories do not represent field censoring.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.look_elsewhere_effect: Three folds and metrics were fixed before execution.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Encoder, folds, calibration length and quantile were preregistered.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.correlation_causation: Time ordering is not physical damage causation.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.reverse_causality: Chronology is preserved; no causal mechanism is claimed.
